english.note: Use this as the all-purpose locative construction for being physically outside A.
Use this specifically to say that something is outside the boundary or area of A.

examples.english: Wait for me outside the house.
examples.jyutping: hai2 gaan1 uk1 ceot1 min6 dang2 ngo5 laa1

examples.english: The car is parked off the road.
examples.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 paak3 zo2 hai2 maa5 lou6 ceot1 min6
